title_en: SpaceX launches intelligence-gathering satellites for the National Reconnaissance Office
summary_en: The NROL-136 mission was the fourth launch of the year supporting the agency’s proliferated architecture satellite constellation in low Earth orbit. Liftoff from pad 4E at Vandenberg Space Force Base happened at 4:23 a.m. PST (7:23 a.m. EST / 1223 UTC).

title_en: AST SpaceMobile unveils $1.3 billion engine deal with Firefly Aerospace to power new heavy-lift rocket
summary_en: The company behind the Bluebird direct-to-cell satellite constellation said the addition of its own heavy-lift rocket is the final piece of its plans for vertical integration.

summary_ru: Компания, стоящая за группировкой спутников прямой связи Bluebird, заявила, что добавление собственной тяжелой ракеты является заключительным этапом ее планов по вертикальной интеграции.
